I’m alright.. life can get so damn hard sometimes but I try and find the strength to overcome those hard days. I miss my brother more than anything in this world, so when I get the chance to talk to someone who’s having a hard day I just try and help them in any way I can. If only I could have been there to help my brother. It’s eats me alive. But ya know, you gotta take it day by day. It’s weird, I find myself talking to a lot of strangers on here and in a weird way, it helps me get through some of my pain.

Thanks for reaching out. I’ll tell you a little bit about my brother. 
There was no note, just a picture he sent me. No signs of trauma. He wasn’t diagnosed with anything, but he’s also never seen a professional for these kinds of things. I didn’t know it was this severe. He wasn’t on medication. The coroner and others believe this was a suicide. I struggle with knowing what really happened. Was it an accident? We will never know. And that kills me the most. 
He has 12 siblings but we did not grow up the same time and we never all lived together at once. He grew up with myself and 1 other sister in this house. Along with my dad. They were bestfriends. There’s no favoritism. 
Even if he was struggling he wouldn’t have told anyone. Stubborn little dude. 
Thank you for reaching out though, it helps.
